title: Mega-Sena rolls over to R$ 112 million after Draw 3,068
seoTitle: Mega-Sena rolls over to R$ 112 million
subtitle: No player matched the six numbers drawn on Thursday (8)
excerpt: The Mega-Sena prize rolled over and is estimated at R$ 112 million for the next draw after Contest 3,068 ended with no jackpot winners.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Result of Mega-Sena Draw 3,068

The Mega-Sena prize rolled over again. In Draw 3,068, held on Thursday (8), no bettor managed to match the six drawn numbers. As a result, the estimated prize for the next draw rose to R$ 112 million.

The numbers drawn were: 07 - 10 - 39 - 40 - 43 - 57.

Quina Prize

Although nobody claimed the top prize, there were winners in the secondary tiers. A total of 62 bets matched five numbers and will receive R$ 51,808 each.

How prize rollovers work

In lottery draws, the main prize is awarded to players who match all the drawn numbers. When there are no winners in this tier, the prize money rolls over to the next contest, increasing the estimated amount for the following draw.

Draws are held periodically and also distribute proportional prizes to those who match smaller groups of numbers. The general rules state that prizes roll over whenever the top tier is not hit, allowing the estimated jackpot to grow with each draw that lacks a maximum‑tier winner. Participants select their numbers and the official draws determine the winning numbers.

With information from Agência Brasil.
